patch_description: This crossover version blends the strongest parts of the prior programs while explicitly targeting the main failure mode: regime-specific features that collapse out-of-sample. It emphasizes shorter lookbacks, rolling z-score normalization, change-of-market-character features, and a few robust interactions such as momentum × volatility regime. The model is made slightly less over-regularized to reduce mean-collapsing while still controlling overfit with modest depth and sample subsampling. The feature set stays safely below 80 columns and uses only past data.
